implementation.targetScope: Stable Reselect 5.3 selector creators, structured selectors, LRU and weak argument caches, bounded generational caches, counters, typed-state helpers and development diagnostics. Experimental autotracking from older releases is not included; it is absent from the current public API. Diagnostic wording and type-level utility aliases are not an exact upstream reproduction.

changes: No runtime dependencies. Written from public documentation, declarations and black-box controls; upstream runtime source was not read or copied.
Weak object/function branches and weak references for previous object results avoid making cache history a strong owner of arguments or results.
Latest 5.3 primitive-cache bounds and development growth warnings are supported alongside the app-pinned 5.1.1 selectors.
Structured output uses own properties, including prototype-named keys. Development mode is fixed at module initialization so production cache hits do not repeatedly inspect the process environment.

appContract.scope: Transitive foundation under @mui/x-internals 8.7.0, installed through MUI X date/grid packages. VentiMath directly imports MUI X DateTimePicker in calendar EventDialog and NoteFormReminder, and its date adapter/provider at app roots. It does not import Reselect directly. Tests execute the unchanged MUI X store selector wrapper; they do not establish route-level reachability of that wrapper or claim application adoption.
